title: multi check names a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md in a parent directory of a bare twin's sandbox, which claude loads by walking up
goal: sandbox_leaks (or multi check) names a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md in any parent directory of a bare twin's sandbox up to the filesystem root, and a user-level ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, as a kb leak

run:
import os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_multi
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
d = os.path.join(T, 'bare', 'agent1'); os.makedirs(d)
open(os.path.join(T, 'CLAUDE.md'), 'w').write('use the kb')
found = bench_multi.sandbox_leaks(d)
assert any('CLAUDE.md' in t for _, t in found), 'a CLAUDE.md in a parent of the twin sandbox is not named'
